children: Hyperliquid Labs co-founder Jeff Yan is seeking U.S. rules to protect the blockchain and place regulatory responsibility on financial institutions operating markets on it, rather than on the network itself. According to ChainCatcher, Yan says this approach could let Hyperliquid enter Wall Street without bearing the full compliance burden of a traditional exchange. Hyperliquid is not yet open to U.S. customers, and Yan says it aims to provide underlying trading technology for traditional financial institutions rather than replace existing market participants. He likened the role to Amazon Web Services, which provides computing infrastructure to businesses.

title: Hyperliquid Co-Founder Jeff Yan Seeks U.S. Rules to Protect Blockchain and Place Oversight at Application Layer
